name: Bidirectional-energy-flow qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies an energy interface intended to operate in both directions.
description: This qualifier identifies an energy interface intended to operate in both directions. Storage and conversion systems can exchange energy in opposite directions under different modes. A bidirectional qualifier describes that capability without defining when either direction is enabled.
Name the charge/discharge or import/export modes and their interfaces. The operating strategy and protective controls are documented separately from the energy-flow mark.
readingNotes: State the supported operating modes and associated control conditions.
A bidirectional energy indication does not by itself certify grid-forming or islanding capability.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
